# LeadPilot AI CRM — Release Notes v0.5.0

**Release Date:** July 26, 2026  
**Module:** Task & Activity Management Module  

---

## 1. Module Overview

Tasks constitute the operational execution layer of LeadPilot AI CRM. Release v0.5.0 delivers a production-grade Task & Activity Management module backed by a live Supabase database repository (`SupabaseTaskRepository`). Tasks seamlessly integrate with Leads, Contacts, Deals, Timeline, AI Copilot, and future Calendar scheduling systems.

---

## 2. Key Features & Architecture

### A. Database Schema & Strict RLS ([`supabase/migrations/20260726130000_create_tasks_table.sql`](file:///c:/Users/Hari%20Om%20Kumar/Desktop/GitHub%20Projects/SaaS%20Project/leadpilot-ai/supabase/migrations/20260726130000_create_tasks_table.sql))
- `public.tasks`: Task attributes (`id`, `title`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `category`, `due_date`, `assigned_to`, `contact_id`, `lead_id`, `deal_id`, `tags`).
- `public.task_comments`: Threaded comments with author metadata and timestamps.
- `public.task_activity`: Immutable audit trail for task events (`Task Created`, `Task Assigned`, `Task Updated`, `Task Completed`, `Task Archived`, `Comment Added`).
- Enforces strict Row Level Security (RLS) policies (**no `USING (true)`**).

### B. Production Repository Pattern ([`src/infrastructure/repositories/SupabaseTaskRepository.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Hari%20Om%20Kumar/Desktop/GitHub%20Projects/SaaS%20Project/leadpilot-ai/leadpilot-frontend/src/infrastructure/repositories/SupabaseTaskRepository.ts))
- Implements `TaskRepository` interface:
  - `getTasks` & `getTaskById`
  - `createTask` & `updateTask`
  - `deleteTask` & `deleteTasks`
  - `completeTask` & `archiveTask` & `assignTask`
  - `searchTasks` & `filterTasks` & `bulkUpdateStatus`
  - `getTaskComments` & `addComment` & `deleteComment`
  - `getTaskActivity`

### C. Multi-Entity Relationships & Cross-Module Timeline Integration
- Directly links tasks to `Lead`, `Contact`, or `Deal` records without schema duplication.
- When a task linked to a contact is created or completed, an event is automatically appended to `contact_timeline`.

### D. User Interface & Kanban Workspace ([`src/app/(dashboard)/tasks/page.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Hari%20Om%20Kumar/Desktop/GitHub%20Projects/SaaS%20Project/leadpilot-ai/leadpilot-frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/tasks/page.tsx))
- Supports 3 view modes: **Grid View**, **Table View**, and **Kanban View** (`src/components/tasks/task-kanban.tsx`).
- Integrated Task Details Drawer, Create/Edit Modals, Search, Priority Badges, and Status Assignment Modals.

### E. Executive Dashboard Widgets ([`src/components/dashboard/task-widgets.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Hari%20Om%20Kumar/Desktop/GitHub%20Projects/SaaS%20Project/leadpilot-ai/leadpilot-frontend/src/components/dashboard/task-widgets.tsx))
- Added operational widgets:
  - Today's Tasks
  - Overdue Tasks
  - Upcoming Tasks
  - Completion Rate

### F. AI Task Intelligence Tool ([`src/domain/ai/tools/TaskTool.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Hari%20Om%20Kumar/Desktop/GitHub%20Projects/SaaS%20Project/leadpilot-ai/leadpilot-frontend/src/domain/ai/tools/TaskTool.ts))
- Exposes `task_intelligence_tool` to the AI Assistant for analyzing task urgencies, overdue deadlines, and assigned brokers.

---

## 3. Telemetry & Observability

Logged via `platformAuditLogger`:
- `Task Created`
- `Task Updated`
- `Task Assigned`
- `Task Completed`
- `Task Archived`
- `Comment Added`
